title: The Signal — EN/JA/ZH (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 98bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual cosmic
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Before the frequency there was silence
Before the silence there was something
DEPHYRIER doesn't explain
DEPHYRIER transmits

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
音符の間の空間でそれを聞いたことがある [You've heard it in the space between the notes]
答えの前の間 [The pause before the answer]
言葉が届く前の半秒 [The half-second before the word arrives]
そこにDEPHYRIERが住んでいる [That's where DEPHYRIER lives]

[Chorus — English]
Signal in the dark
Signal through the static
Signal when you thought there was nothing left to hear
DEPHYRIER is the frequency
DEPHYRIER is the signal that was always here

[Bridge — 中文]
不是声音 [Not a voice]
不是音响 [Not a sound]
是一种传输 [A transmission]
是一种载波 [A carrier wave]
是你正在听的东西之下的某样东西 [Something underneath the thing you were listening to]
它已经在承载着别的东西 [That was already carrying something else]

[Verse 3 — English]
DEPHYRIER is not the sender
DEPHYRIER is the moment the receiver wakes up

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
The signal
信号 [The signal]
信号 [The signal]
DEPHYRIER
